description.value: Little Straw Vineyards is one of the Okanagan's oldest family estate wineries, with vineyard roots dating to 1969 when the Slamka family first planted in West Kelowna. Now under the stewardship of the Sidhu family, the 12-acre estate is transitioning toward organic certification and hosts TULA Restaurant, offering refined Indian cuisine alongside its VQA wines. Touring cyclists on the Okanagan wine route can combine vineyard tastings and guided tours with a full sit-down meal at this historic property.

address.value: 2815 Ourtoland Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 2H7
